skill.summary: 蓝信官方图文卡片发送能力，支持发送包含图片和文字的图文卡片消息。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of lanxin-app-articles.

- Supports sending Lanxin official article cards with images and text.
- Strict rules: must output clean JSON for appArticles with all required fields, no extra text or formatting allowed.
- Multiple trigger phrases for flexible activation.
- Detailed field descriptions and compliance requirements included in documentation.
